name: Chatbase
tagline: Platform for building and deploying AI agents for customer support, sales, and product guidance.
description: Chatbase lets teams train AI agents on their own content (websites, docs, files) and deploy them across live chat, email, phone, Slack, WhatsApp, and other channels. It includes analytics, testing, integrations with helpdesks and CRMs, and AI Actions that let agents take steps in connected systems. The company reports over 10,000 business customers and holds SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA-eligible compliance posture.
pricing_details: Free plan at $0 with 50 message credits/month. Paid plans billed annually: Hobby $32/mo, Standard $120/mo, Pro $400/mo; Enterprise custom. Add-ons include extra agents and branding removal.
use_cases: Automating customer support across chat, email, and voice
Building a sales agent that qualifies and guides prospects
Embedding a docs-trained chatbot on a website
Deflecting repetitive tickets from human support teams
Running product guidance and onboarding conversations
pros: Fast no-code setup and training on own data
Broad channel and helpdesk/CRM integration coverage
Free tier and transparent tiered pricing
Compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA-eligible)
cons: Message-credit model can get expensive at higher volumes
Key capabilities (more models, actions, seats) locked to upper tiers

name: Watermelon
tagline: AI agent for customer service that resolves conversations across chat, email, and social channels.
description: Watermelon provides an AI agent that answers customer questions, executes actions in connected systems, and hands off to humans through a shared inbox when needed. It supports website chat, email, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram, and integrates with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce. The company is ISO 27001 certified and hosts data in the EU.
pricing_details: Free plan includes 50 conversations/month. Paid tiers (Starter, Advanced, Business) raise limits to 250, 500, and 1,000 conversations/month with add-ons at EUR 25/month each; exact euro prices were not shown in the fetched page text. Yearly billing saves 15%.

Reducing phone support volume with self-service AI answers

tagline: AI customer support agent trained on your website, docs, and resolved tickets.
description: Weav builds a support agent by connecting to a company's website, documentation, and files, and claims to resolve over 70% of customer questions autonomously. name: Heyy
tagline: AI employees that automate sales, marketing, and support on WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger.
description: Heyy lets businesses create configurable 'AI Employees' that handle customer conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and a website chat widget. It includes campaigns, a mini-CRM, a shared inbox, automations, and API access, with credit-based usage for AI interactions. Setup is no-code, and integrations connect CRMs, e-commerce, and ticketing tools.

name: Comp AI
tagline: AI compliance automation for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and more frameworks.
description: Comp AI automates compliance programs by collecting evidence from a company's stack, mapping it to controls, drafting policies, and answering security questionnaires. Controls map across frameworks, so adding ISO 27001 to an existing SOC 2 program starts largely complete. The platform also bundles expert-run penetration testing and a live Trust Center for sharing compliance status with buyers, and reports 830+ customer companies.

name: AI Fiesta
tagline: One subscription to chat with ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, and DeepSeek side by side.
description: AI Fiesta aggregates multiple premium AI models into a single chat interface, letting users compare answers side by side and toggle models mid-conversation. It includes prompt enhancement, image generation, audio transcription, custom projects with system instructions, and a 'Super Fiesta' mode that auto-selects a model. Launched in August 2025 by YouTuber Dhruv Rathee with TagMango co-founders, it targets price-sensitive users, especially in India with UPI payments.
pricing_details: $12/month or discounted annual billing (India: Rs. 999/month, Rs. 833/month annual) with 3 million tokens/month; premium models consume tokens at 4x. Payments are non-refundable except for billing errors.

Image generation and audio transcription alongside chat

name: Supercut
tagline: AI-powered video messaging: record up to 4K, auto-edit, and share instantly with your team.
description: Supercut is a video messaging and screen recording tool with native macOS and Windows recorders capturing up to 4K. AI features auto-edit recordings (removing silences and filler words), generate chapters, titles, summaries, and multi-language transcripts, and videos are shared instantly via branded links with calls to action, comments, and view analytics. name: Clico
tagline: Browser extension that puts AI writing help inside every text box on the web.
description: Clico is a Chromium browser extension that opens an AI assistant inside any text field via a keyboard shortcut, reading the visible page for context so users can draft, rewrite, summarize, search, or dictate without switching tabs. It works across Gmail, Google Docs, Notion, Slack, LinkedIn, and other sites, requires no API key, and skips password and payment fields for privacy. It launched on Product Hunt in March 2026.

name: Maple
tagline: Voice AI for restaurants that answers calls, takes orders, and manages reservations 24/7.
description: Maple is a voice AI platform that answers restaurant phone calls around the clock, taking pickup and delivery orders directly into POS systems (including Toast, SkyTab, and TRAY) and handling reservations through OpenTable and SevenRooms. It also fields catering inquiries, hours, directions, and FAQs, and reports over 1 million calls answered for 1,000+ restaurants with a resolution rate above 90% without human intervention. The New York-based company launched in December 2023 and graduated from the AWS Generative AI Accelerator.
pricing_details: Pricing is not published on the public site; the company sells through demos and POS-partner channels (TRAY, SkyTab), so plans are quoted per restaurant.
